contract.title: Boundary-generator card DC0 (dispatch scope wave-c-seed, next DC1)
contract.invariant: DC0 binds the wave-boundary tree through the R0.1V-owned verifier, then invokes the one R0.1B-owned dispatch CLI with literals fixed by the boundary card; the card-set manifest (schemaVersion ranking_v3_dispatch_cards_v2) contains the target scope plus the next boundary-generator card DC1; every card resolves to a §7.5/§7.6 catalog row; no executing agent chooses an argument or discovers a file.
approved_files: DC0: card-generation task; produces the card-set directory $CARD_SET_DIR only; no source file ownership
interface_changes: card-set manifest for scope wave-c-seed (schemaVersion ranking_v3_dispatch_cards_v2; baselineCommit frozen; dispatchCommit + dispatchTreeSha256 bound; prerequisiteReceipts; cards[])
next generator DC1 present but nondispatchable until the current scope's gate receipt exists
security_boundaries: Dispatch authority comes only from the latest unrevoked card-set manifest; a new manifest revokes only overlapping unexecuted cards
Next generator DC1 is nondispatchable until the current scope gate receipt exists — prevents meta-dispatch deadlock
No executing agent chooses a CLI argument or discovers a file; all arguments come from named prerequisite receipts
overlap_with: FT-G1 (R1.0B/R1.6 contract covers the same §7.4 CLI shape; this card extends it to later wave boundaries)
contract.instructions:
READ-ONLY fleshing-out of the dispatch contract for boundary generator DC0 (scope wave-c-seed, next DC1). Exact §7.4 command shape:
node scripts/verify-ranking-v3-rebase.mjs snapshot-tree --head "$DISPATCH_COMMIT" --out "$TASK_OUTPUT/DISPATCH_TREE.json"
node scripts/ranking-v3-dispatch-cards.mjs build --scope "$SCOPE_ID" --baseline-commit "$BASELINE_COMMIT" --dispatch-commit "$DISPATCH_COMMIT" --dispatch-tree-manifest "$DISPATCH_TREE_MANIFEST" --qualification-target "$QUALIFICATION_TARGET_OR_NONE" --contract-seal "$CONTRACT_SEAL_OR_NONE" --task-graph "$TASK_GRAPH_OR_NONE" --expansion-receipts "$EXPANSION_RECEIPT_INDEX" --previous-manifest "$PREVIOUS_CARD_MANIFEST_OR_NONE" --include-next-generator "$NEXT_GENERATOR_ID_OR_NONE" --out "$CARD_SET_DIR"
node scripts/ranking-v3-dispatch-cards.mjs verify --manifest "$CARD_SET_DIR/cards.manifest.json"
with $SCOPE_ID=wave-c-seed and $NEXT_GENERATOR_ID_OR_NONE=DC1 as literals fixed by the boundary card; $DISPATCH_COMMIT is the integration HEAD named by the preceding gate receipt. Output: C1/C1G/DC1 card set. Focused command targets future tool test files (plan-specified, unverifiable-at-base); affected command is repo-verified.
